metric_direction.AUROC: baseline minus removed; positive means task degradation
metric_direction.AUPRC: baseline minus removed; positive means task degradation
metric_direction.Brier: removed minus baseline; positive means task degradation
metric_direction.ECE: removed minus baseline; positive means task degradation

continuous_target.valid_if: held-out excess probe association is reduced by at least 90 percent OR post-removal absolute Pearson correlation is at most 0.20

categorical_target.valid_if: held-out excess probe discrimination is reduced by at least 90 percent OR post-removal AUROC is within 0.45 to 0.55

removal_validity.collateral_damage_flag: any registered non-target held-out selectivity loses at least 50 percent relative to baseline
removal_validity.primary_direction_confirmation: ROI/input intervention must agree in direction; disagreement makes the primary use claim inconclusive

use_effect.raw_use: task metric degradation after semantic removal
use_effect.excess_use: raw use minus mean matched-random raw use

conditions: empirical one-sided p is at most 0.05
excess AUROC degradation is at least 0.01

performance_matching.one_standard_error_unit: inner held-out acquisition domain after averaging seeds
performance_matching.eligible_if: configuration mean inner-domain AUROC is at least best mean minus the standard error of the best configuration

performance_only: restrict to the one-standard-error eligible set
smaller mean absolute calibration-slope distance from 1
lexical configuration id as deterministic final tie-break
audit_guided: restrict to the identical one-standard-error eligible set
prefer zero invalid four-core-joint or conditional-hippocampal removal conditions; otherwise fewer invalid conditions
fewer validated acquisition-use violations across manufacturer, field strength, phase, and domain identity
lower sample variance across inner domains of four-core-joint excess AUROC use after seed averaging
higher median valid conditional-hippocampal excess AUROC use across inner domains
smaller mean absolute calibration-slope distance from 1
lexical configuration id as deterministic final tie-break

outer_domain_prohibition: No outer-domain labels, metrics, probes, audit effects, or calibration outcomes may alter thresholds or selection.
